cpi.source: FRED, BLS CPI-U seasonally adjusted: CPIAUCSL (headline), CPILFESL (core), CPIENGSL (energy)
cpi.licence: US government work, public domain; citation requested

sp500.label: S&P 500, total return
sp500.source: Robert J. Shiller, ie_data.xls: monthly average price plus one twelfth of trailing twelve-month dividends

treasury10.label: 10-year Treasury, constant-maturity approximation
treasury10.source: Shiller GS10 yield; par 10-year semiannual bond repriced monthly plus coupon accrual (approximation)

tbill.label: 3-month Treasury bills
tbill.source: FRED TB3MS, prior month's rate divided by twelve

gold.label: Gold, spot
gold.source: World Bank Pink Sheet, gold $/troy oz, monthly average (CC BY 4.0)

commodities.label: Commodities, World Bank total index, spot
commodities.source: World Bank Pink Sheet, Total index 2010=100, spot (CC BY 4.0)

energy.label: Energy commodities, World Bank index, spot
energy.source: World Bank Pink Sheet, Energy index 2010=100, spot (CC BY 4.0)

notes: Index levels, base 100 at the first month. Regress monthly or trailing 12-month percent changes on the matching CPI change to reproduce the guide's betas.
Commodity and gold series are spot prices, not collateralized futures returns.
The 10-year Treasury series is a yield-based approximation, not a bond index.
